definition: RotatingControl refers literally to the existing Models.NecessarilyUnderived.rotating Ontic interpretation: two universally accessible Bool worlds, two Bool candidates present in both worlds, and one edge false→true at false with the reverse edge true→false at true. Ordinary Causes is selected explicitly as the support relation. The proposition conjoins actual reflexivity, necessity of both candidates, each candidate's full OtherDirectedPotentialCause role, well-founded present-source support at every world, failure of union necessary-support well-foundedness, and distinctness false≠true. It is one joint interpretation, not a combination of separate model witnesses.
note: Reuses the registered rotating model without changing its data. The extra potential-role facts make it a control to replacing cross-world union WF with merely worldwise WF. Formal consistency here does not establish metaphysical possibility.
